resources.name: SubmitHub
resources.description: The original music submission platform. Send your tracks directly to bloggers, playlist curators, and influencers. Free submissions (slow response) or premium credits (~$1–3 per submission) for guaranteed feedback within 48 hours.

resources.name: Groover
resources.description: Pitch your music to curators, media outlets, influencers, radio stations, and record labels. Pay-per-pitch model with a guaranteed response within 7 days. Strong European and international curator network.

resources.name: MusoSoup
resources.description: PR and promotion platform connecting independent musicians with music bloggers, playlisters, and podcasters. Automated campaign management with per-blog pricing and real-time tracking.

resources.name: One Submit
resources.description: Submit to over 2,200 music curators across Spotify playlists, TikTok influencers, music blogs, YouTube channels, magazines, and online radio stations — all from a single submission form.

resources.name: HumanHuman
resources.description: Music discovery and promotion platform that connects artists with tastemakers and influencers for authentic promotion. Focuses on genuine discovery rather than paid placements.
resources.cost: Free to submit; premium plans available

resources.name: Songfluencer
resources.description: Music-focused influencer marketing agency that pairs your track with vetted TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creators. They manage the entire campaign — creator selection, briefing, content approval, and reporting.

resources.name: SpaceLoud
resources.description: Self-serve marketplace where artists set their own budgets, browse influencer profiles, and manage campaigns directly. Good for artists who want hands-on control over creator selection and spending.

resources.name: Sound.me (by Playlist Push)
resources.description: Influencer campaign platform from the team behind Playlist Push. Connects artists with TikTok and Instagram creators who use your track in their content. Automated matching based on genre and creator audience.

resources.name: Kolsquare
resources.description: Influencer marketing platform with a database of over 3 million KOL (Key Opinion Leader) profiles across all social platforms. Search by niche, audience demographics, engagement rate, and more.

resources.name: Playlist Push
resources.description: One of the most established playlist promotion platforms. Matches your music with independent Spotify playlist curators based on genre. Also offers TikTok influencer campaigns. Transparent feedback from every curator.

resources.name: SubmitLink
resources.description: Submission tool for playlist curators that also serves artists. Create a submission link for your track and share it with curators. Free for artists; curators use it to manage their inbox.

resources.name: Soundplate
resources.description: Spotify playlist directory and submission tool. Browse thousands of playlists by genre, mood, and size. Submit your track directly to playlists that accept submissions. Free tier available.

resources.name: PlaylistSupply
resources.description: Spotify playlist analytics and discovery tool. Find playlists that match your genre, see their growth trends, and identify curators who are actively adding new music.

resources.name: Hypeddit
resources.description: Free music promotion tools including smart links, fan-gating pages, and a repost exchange network. Widely used in electronic and dance music but works across genres.

resources.name: Playlist Push TikTok
resources.description: Dedicated TikTok campaign service from Playlist Push. They match your track with TikTok creators who make organic-feeling content using your song. Pay per creator and track performance metrics.

resources.name: Indie Music Academy
resources.description: Music marketing education and promotion services with a strong focus on TikTok and social media strategy for independent artists. Offers courses, coaching, and done-for-you promotion.

resources.name: Ditto Music Promotions
resources.description: Promotion arm of Ditto Music distribution. Offers TikTok influencer campaigns, Spotify playlist pitching, and social media promotion packages. Convenient if you already distribute through Ditto.

resources.name: Vampr Publishing
resources.description: Social networking app for musicians that also offers sync licensing and promotional tools. Good for discovering and connecting directly with content creators who might use your music.

resources.name: Feature.fm
resources.description: Smart links, pre-save pages, and marketing analytics for musicians. Create landing pages that route fans to their preferred streaming platform. Essential for tracking the results of influencer campaigns.

resources.name: Linkfire
resources.description: Industry-standard smart link platform used by major labels and indie artists alike. Create beautiful landing pages, track clicks by geography and platform, and integrate with ad platforms.

resources.name: ToneDen
resources.description: Social marketing suite with smart links, social unlocks (fan-gating), and automated ad campaigns. Fan-gating lets you require a Spotify follow or playlist add before unlocking content — powerful for boosting streams from influencer traffic.

resources.name: Songwhip
resources.description: Free, instant smart link generator. Paste any music link and get a clean landing page with all streaming platforms. No account needed. Perfect for quick sharing in influencer DMs and pitches.

resources.name: Feedspot
resources.description: Database of 250,000+ active influencers across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter in 1,500+ niche categories. Search for music influencers by platform, genre, and audience size. Offers contact lists with email addresses.

resources.name: Social Blade
resources.description: Free analytics tool for checking any public social media account's follower growth, engagement trends, and estimated earnings. Essential for vetting influencers before you reach out — spot fake followers and declining accounts.

resources.name: HypeAuditor
resources.description: AI-powered influencer analytics and fraud detection platform. Analyzes audience quality, engagement authenticity, and demographics. Helps you avoid paying for influencers with fake or bot followers.

resources.name: Chartmetric
resources.description: Music industry analytics platform that tracks playlist placements, social media growth, and audience data across all platforms. See which playlists and influencers are driving streams for artists in your genre.

resources.name: SpotOnTrack
resources.description: Free Spotify analytics tool that tracks your playlist placements, follower growth, and streaming trends over time. Useful for measuring the impact of influencer and playlist campaigns.
